result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The one clear defect is the empty profile avatar in the header, which shows only a red notification dot. There is also a minor redundancy on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: The circular profile/avatar button in the top-right header is an empty light-gray circle with only a red notification dot. No user photo, initials or fallback icon is shown, so the image probably failed to load or no fallback was set. Its purpose is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Show the user's avatar image, with a fallback to initials or a generic person/bell icon when the image is missing or fails to load. Add an accessible label (e.g. 'Profile, 1 new notification').

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Keep the badge as the highlight and drop the duplicate from the metadata line, or use the metadata slot for other useful info such as price level.
